instruction: Add all spotify-recommended R&B songs released in this year to a new "R&B Recommendation" playlist.
notes: Single-app (spotify) task plus supervisor lookups and phone.get_current_date_and_time to fix 'this year'. Recommended songs are modeled as four representative objects: two satisfy both filters (R&B genre, released in 2023) and two fail one filter each; genre/release facts are static world facts gated by (song-details-known ?s) from spotify.show_song and (datetime-known) from the phone date API, so the planner can only add qualifying songs. The number of qualifying songs is unknown a priori; the problem instantiates two, and supervisor-complete-task takes the playlist and the two added songs as non-API record parameters so its precondition equals the goal. A real agent should call show_song for every recommended song (listed in api_sequence); the planner's minimal plan inspects only the qualifying ones. Goal demands exactly one new playlist titled 'R&B Recommendation' containing exactly the qualifying songs; show_song needs no token; create_playlist uses default privacy.
